selection: Original Phase 1 development IDs only; all order theorems held apart; refit only after selection. Phase 3 held-out diagnostics never train.

models.objective: squared error of log1p observed remaining candidate attempts, verified nonterminal continuations only

uncertainty: Paired theorem-cluster bootstrap of repeat averages; eight-family cluster sensitivity. Common-verified comparisons separately, no failure-as-efficiency claim.
generator: Protected original generate_candidates; separate exploratory extended-generator runs are excluded from primary summary.
repeated_states: Native expression replay diagnostics only, no semantic merges or pruning. Beam eviction is explicit search-space management, never equivalence.
secondary_references: Native Aesop and installed grind: one external call, incomparable internal candidate/state units. No unsupported reproduction of other published results.
pilot: Six original development-only tasks, BFS and handcrafted, before freeze. No learned scoring or final-test outcomes used in difficulty selection. 4/6 solved; lattice/inverse fail; all final families retained.
